info.description: Our very own OG Social Media.
info.title: Yorgut APIs

post.description: Validates the Google ID token from Sign in with Google, creates the user on their first login, and returns a Yorgut session token. Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" on every other request.
post.summary: Logs in with a Google account.

get.description: Returns an array of communities
get.summary: Get Multiple communities.

post.description: Creates a community owned by the logged user, optionally with a picture (PNG or JPEG, max 1 MB and 1024x1024).

get.description: Returns a page of communities the logged user is not a member of, biggest first.
get.summary: Searches communities the logged user hasn't joined.

parameters.description: Part of the community name (omit to list all)
parameters.name: name

get.description: Returns the community matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single community by id.

put.description: Replaces the community's name, category and description. Only the owner may (403 otherwise).

get.description: Returns a list of topics
get.summary: Gets the 5 most recently replied topics of a community.

get.description: Returns a list of the community members matching the requested id and a few stats
get.summary: Get community members.

put.description: Uploads a PNG or JPEG (max 1 MB and 1024x1024) as the community's picture. Only the owner may (403 otherwise).

get.description: Returns the community profile matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single community profile by its id.

get.description: Returns an array of communities (for now, every community)
get.summary: Get Related communities.

get.description: Returns a list of topics
get.summary: Gets the 10 most recently replied topics of a community.

delete.description: The logged user leaves a community (same as /me/leave). userId must be the logged user (403 otherwise), and the owner can't leave (403).

parameters.description: User ID (must be the logged user)
parameters.name: userId

post.description: Logged user makes a new friendship request.

delete.summary: Deletes a Friendship by the target userId Id.

get.description: Returns the user that owns the session token
get.summary: Get the logged user.

put.description: Replaces the logged user's basic data and profile fields. Email can't be changed.

get.description: Returns a list of friends
get.summary: Gets a list of friends of the user.

get.description: Returns a list of users
get.summary: Gets a list of friendship invites of the user.

get.description: Returns the friendship status between the logged user and userId. Answers 204 with no body when userId is the logged user.
get.summary: Evaluates if the logged user is friend of specified user

post.description: Leaves a community. The owner can't leave (403).

get.description: Returns a list of communities
get.summary: Gets a list of communities that user is member of.

get.description: Returns true or false
get.summary: Evaluates if the logged user is member of specified community

get.description: Returns a list of communities
get.summary: Gets a list of communities that user owns.

get.description: Returns the user matching the token
get.summary: Get logged user with it's profile by their Token.

put.description: Uploads a PNG or JPEG (max 1 MB and 1024x1024) as the logged user's profile picture.
put.summary: Update the logged user's profile picture

get.description: Returns the user stats
get.summary: Get user stats for the Home Welcome

post.description: Adds a PNG or JPEG (max 1 MB and 1024x1024) to the logged user's personal album, which holds up to 15 photos (409 when full).
post.summary: Uploads a photo to the logged user's album.

get.description: Returns the album's photos (newest first), how many it holds and its limit.
get.summary: Lists the photos of a user's personal album.

delete.description: Removes one of the logged user's photos.
delete.summary: Deletes a photo from the logged user's album.

delete.description: Not implemented yet: always answers 501. The route has no scrap id yet.

get.description: Returns a list of scraps
get.summary: Gets a list of scraps of a user.

post.description: Logged user writes a testimonial for a friend. It stays pending until the recipient approves it.

get.description: Returns the approved testimonials of a user. When the logged user is the recipient, pending ones are included too.
get.summary: Gets the testimonials of a user.

parameters.description: Page of approved testimonials, starting at 1 (omit for all)
parameters.name: page

delete.description: The recipient rejects or removes a testimonial, or the author deletes one they wrote.

post.description: The recipient approves a pending testimonial, making it public.
Creates a new Topic inside a community's forum. Only members of the community may post (403 otherwise).
Replies to an existing Topic inside a community's forum. Only members of the topic's community may reply (403 otherwise).

get.description: Returns the topic and its replies
get.summary: Lists all the replies of a given topic

get.description: Returns a list of users
get.summary: Gets a list of users.

get.description: Returns a page of users
get.summary: Searches for a user by their name.

parameters.description: Part of the user's full name (omit to list all)
parameters.name: name

get.description: Returns the user matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single user by id.

put.description: Logged user becomes a fan of a friend. Idempotent.
put.summary: Becomes a fan of a user.

delete.description: Logged user removes their star from a user. Idempotent.
delete.summary: Stops being a fan of a user.

get.description: Returns how many fans a user has, and whether the logged user is (or can become) one of them.
get.summary: Gets the fan summary of a user.

get.description: Returns a list of friends
get.summary: Gets a list of friends of the user.

get.description: Returns a list of communities
get.summary: Gets a list of communities that user is member of.

get.description: Returns the user matching the requested id
get.summary: Get Single user with it's profile by id.

put.description: Logged user creates or updates their review of a friend.

get.description: Returns the average cool, sexy and trustworthy ratings of a user, plus the logged user's own review.
get.summary: Gets the review summary of a user.

canUpload.description: CanUpload is true when the logged user owns the album.

maxPhotos.description: MaxPhotos is how many photos the personal album can hold.

pending.description: Pending is only filled when the recipient is the one looking.

testimonials.description: Testimonials holds the approved testimonials, visible to everyone.

token.description: Token is the Yorgut session token, sent back as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

credential.description: Credential is the Google ID token returned by Sign in with Google.

birthDate.description: BirthDate is a calendar date, "YYYY-MM-DD"; empty keeps the current one.

BearerAuth.description: Yorgut session token from POST /auth/google, sent as "Bearer <token>".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
